meta.title: Siaya County education and human development: enrolment, teachers, VTCs, bursaries (by source and vintage)
meta.rule: Values are printed values from each source; every value has a source, table, PDF page, period, unit, function and confidence. Vintages and publishers are kept separate and never merged. Gaps are listed, never filled; a printed "-" or ".." is never converted to zero. Plan targets and projections are never labelled actual. Aggregates only: no school-, learner- or person-level data.

definitions.function: devolved = county function under the Fourth Schedule (pre-primary/ECDE, village polytechnics/VTCs, county bursaries, county budget); national = national government function (primary, secondary, TVET institutes, TSC teachers, CDF bursaries, surveys and population context)
definitions.value_type: actual; provisional (marked * by the source); baseline (plan baseline); plan_target; approved_estimate; projection; survey_estimate
definitions.confidence: 5 = clean table cell; 4 = table cell with a caveat; 3 = plan table or text with a stated basis; 2 = narrative figure without date or source; 1 = figure with a known problem
definitions.check: ratio check: value = numerator / denominator x scale, rounded to decimals; run only where the same source publishes both
definitions.pdf_page: 1-based page in the PDF file; printed page = pdf_page - printed_page_offset where the source prints page numbers

conflicts.description: 2014 ECDE total pupil-teacher ratio printed as 28.7; the published enrolment and teachers give 33.7. 28.7 is the mean of the public and private ratios.
conflicts.handling: Printed value kept with confidence 2; show the computed 33.7 beside it, labelled as computed.

conflicts.description: The KNBS abstract GERs (ECDE 73.5, primary 117.0, secondary 75.1) do not reproduce from the abstract's own 2014 age-group projections (72.0, 122.9, 69.5). The GER denominator is not stated.
conflicts.handling: Both kept; no GER is recomputed.

conflicts.description: 2019 booklet Tables 49 and 68 print female and male enrolment the other way round from Tables 47 and 66.
conflicts.handling: Sex-specific GERs from Tables 49 and 68 are not recorded; the totals are kept.

conflicts.description: 2019 public primary enrolment: 253,492 (Table 52) vs 249,980 (Table 53, by grade), in the same booklet.
2014 ECDE teachers: 1,926 (MoE booklet, public 1,494 + private 432) vs 1,824 (KNBS abstract, trained 1,031 + untrained 793, Ugunja untrained missing).
conflicts.handling: Shown side by side; different coverage.

conflicts.description: 2014 TSC teachers: primary 5,809 (MoE) vs 5,788 (KNBS, TSC source); secondary 1,861 (MoE) vs 1,967 (KNBS).
CIDP end-2022 "gross enrolment" in ECE (81,771) equals the CIDP's projected 3-5 population for 2022.
conflicts.handling: Kept with confidence 1; do not chart as enrolment without this caveat.

conflicts.description: CIDP (2023 baseline, undated): about 700 ECD centres and 608 ECD teachers. MoE 2019: 679 public pre-primary centres and 1,431 public pre-primary teachers.
conflicts.handling: Shown side by side; different years and probably different definitions of teacher (county-employed vs all in public centres).

conflicts.description: 2019 pre-primary GER of 190.7% implies a denominator of about 52,300 children, while the projected 3-5 population is about 80,000.
conflicts.handling: Kept with confidence 2; not charted as a rate.

conflicts.description: VTCs: 16 institutions listed with enrolment in 2014 (KNBS) vs 35 VTCs in the CIDP (2023).
conflicts.handling: Shown side by side; the KNBS figure is a row count, not a census of VTCs.
